language: zh-TW canonical MD; English structured technical evidence
sourceCommitScope: review-time checkout HEAD; the new analyzer/spec were untracked at review, not a newly claimed benchmark source commit

skill.name: codex-verification
skill.application: Source/artifact/protected-pin audit only. Explicit parent prohibition on new processes takes precedence; no independent acceptance command executed in this review.

scope: Read-only source review plus two own review reports; not formal600 qualification, resource-ceiling stress, product completion or browser evidence

checkedInvariants.requirement: Single original streaming parser and unchanged ceilings
checkedInvariants.details: Exactly one parseTraceStream call; passes original FORMAL compressedBytes/decompressedBytes/events and timeoutMs=300000. Original parser keeps token/nesting/file-change/UTF-8/gzip/structure error behavior. No whole-file parse or second file parse is used by the adapter.

Every callback increments raw ordinal, rejects null/array/primitive events and non-string or >512-character names, and checks heap before the retention predicate. The heap ceiling is original 2147483648 bytes.

checkedInvariants.requirement: Bounded retention without losing boundary or posting-site evidence
checkedInvariants.details: Keeps the original V3 relevant set plus every B/E regardless of owner/name and every known posting-site event regardless of owner/phase/name. All retained rows share the original 536870912-byte serialized limit; there is no extra allowance for B/E. Counts overlap by design and must not be added as disjoint event sets.

checkedInvariants.requirement: Original named task ceiling remains applicable before typed exclusion
checkedInvariants.details: All original task names are retained. Frozen V4 first runs original validateNativeV3 over the full retained candidate set; original TASK_CANDIDATE_CAP at 2000000 is a non-suppressible legacy reason. The classified B cannot reduce raw named-task eligibility into a pass.

checkedInvariants.requirement: Frozen typed boundary and unchanged numeric kernel
checkedInvariants.details: Passes original FORMAL_TRACE_CAPS to frozen validateNativeBoundaryV4; then passes its unchanged validatedTasks/begin/end to original formalNumericV3. No epsilon, clock offset, duration inference, rounding or span rewrite is added. Original 50ms numeric edge and 2-anchor binary64 mapping stay in the original kernel.

checkedInvariants.requirement: Classification source identity and original raw ordinal
checkedInvariants.details: Validates retained index range/integer and reference identity retained[index]===entry.source before replacing eventIndex with the recorded raw index. Preserves source, duration:null and numericIncluded:false.

checkedInvariants.requirement: Full-stream counts separate from bounded input view
checkedInvariants.details: Top-level parsedTraceEvents/rawEventCount and nativeEligibility.rawEventCount use parser stats.events. Input-view/retained counts use retained.length. Named-task counts are accumulated before typed classification. Original V3 legacy rejection remains visible rather than being rewritten.

coverage.complete requires native.qualified===true and numeric.complete===true. The original numeric function rejects native ineligibility and returns empty numeric arrays. No missing measurement is synthesized as zero.

checkedInvariants.requirement: Controlled failure with unknown counts remaining unknown
checkedInvariants.details: Catch preserves the original error text as a rejection reason, full raw counts null, separate parsedEventsBeforeFailure, actual retained count, empty metric arrays, false completeness and null marked duration. A partially parsed prefix is not presented as the full stream.
Both normal and failure paths explicitly ALGORITHM_ONLY, formal600Run:false and NOT_APPROVED. This adapter does not claim elapsed workload or approve the registry.

resourceCaps.timeoutScope: Parser only. This helper is not an end-to-end watchdog or hard continuous peak-memory limiter.

specCoverage.description: Canonical committed short trace hashes, original full-raw V3 rejection, 3306 full events, 938 named vs 937 typed candidates, original source event2377, and bit-exact numeric reference from 47 original validated X spans.
Owned unknown B/E, wrong owner known site, malformed complete task outside window, null/array/scalar objects and exact 512/513 name edge.
Original gzip/CRC/truncation and duplicate traceEvents parser error, producer/executable mismatch, loss and unknown close.

Independent literal original caps; foreign unknown B/E retained +2 without new rejection; prune-before-boundary raw ordinal2378 with unchanged bits; unknown-name wrong-owner known-site X retained +1 while preserving frozen V4 non-rejection semantics.

existingRed.limitation: Missing export is the genuine RED. Guarded downstream tests returned without their semantic assertions; their ok lines are not prior RED counterexample coverage.

existingGreen.limitation: Read the existing TAP; no command rerun in this review. TAP does not independently establish the original process exit code or 600-second workload.

lint.limitation: Empty existing log was inspected; exit0 reported by parent, not independently rerun or established by this empty file.

format.limitation: Existing two-path formatter log inspected; no formatter executed in this review.

frozenPinAudit.method: Read-only Get-FileHash comparison against committed receipt; this is provenance checking, not a test run.

uncoveredMeaningfulGates.proposal: In a later authorized RED slot, a compact valid retained row followed by invalid raw schema can assert full counts stay null, parsedEventsBeforeFailure is a distinct positive prefix count, numeric arrays stay empty and coverage stays false. Existing source handles this; existing reject helper does not inspect these count fields.

uncoveredMeaningfulGates.gate: Native candidate with incomplete numeric edge coverage
uncoveredMeaningfulGates.proposal: In a later authorized RED slot, establish independently a native-qualified fixture whose original numeric kernel reports incomplete coverage, then assert wrapper coverage false and no measured occupancy. Do not relax the original 50ms edge or fabricate 600 seconds.

The short fixture does not exercise 256MiB gzip, 2GiB decoded/heap, 8M events, 2M named tasks, 512MiB retained or 300000ms parse pressure. Source guards were inspected. Do not manufacture huge fixtures or expand APIs in this review.

limits: The result is an independent source/artifact review, not a fresh acceptance execution.
The parser wall budget is not an end-to-end analysis watchdog; the future launcher must retain its explicit operation/watchdog/lease lifecycle.
Heap checks observe stages and per-event samples; this is not proof of a continuously bounded allocation peak.
No new source/spec, frozen input, category, registry, shared memory, original raw or old reject was changed by this review.
